The verified theorem:
theorem Submission.idtp_cse_cone_approxTangent_smul : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, approxTangentPlane n R.carrier (r • x) = approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x := by
  intro P n C R hC hR r hr
  have hscale := Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image P n C R hC hR
  have hM := R.measurableSet_carrier
  have hMc : R.measure R.carrierᶜ = 0 := by
    unfold IMRep.measure
    rw [withDensity_apply _ hM.compl, Measure.restrict_restrict hM.compl]
    simp
  have hle : ∀ S : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ R.carrier → μHE[n] S ≤ R.measure S := by
    intro S hS hSM
    unfold IMRep.measure
    rw [withDensity_apply _ hS, Measure.restrict_restrict hS, inter_eq_left.mpr hSM]
    calc μHE[n] S = ∫⁻ _ in S, 1 ∂μHE[n] := by simp
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in S, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] := by
          refine setLIntegral_mono' hS fun x hx => ?_
          exact_mod_cast R.mult_pos x (hSM hx)
  have hmeas : ∀ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet S →
      MeasurableSet ((fun x => c • x) '' S) := by
    intro c hc S hS
    rw [image_smul]
    exact hS.const_smul_of_ne_zero hc
  have hnull1 : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ (fun x => c • x) '' R.carrier) = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
    have hset : R.carrier \ (fun x => c • x) '' R.carrier =
        (fun x => c • x) '' ((fun x => c⁻¹ • x) '' R.carrier \ R.carrier) := by
      rw [image_sdiff (smul_right_injective _ hc0), image_image]
      simp [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0]
    refine nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp ?_
    calc μHE[n] (R.carrier \ (fun x => c • x) '' R.carrier)
        ≤ R.measure (R.carrier \ (fun x => c • x) '' R.carrier) :=
          hle _ (hM.diff (hmeas c hc0 _ hM)) sdiff_subset
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ n) * R.measure ((fun x => c⁻¹ • x) '' R.carrier \ R.carrier) := by
          rw [hset]
          exact hscale c hc _ ((hmeas _ (inv_ne_zero hc0) _ hM).diff hM)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ n) * R.measure R.carrierᶜ := by
          gcongr
          exact fun x hx => hx.2
      _ = 0 := by rw [hMc, mul_zero]
  have hnull2 : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → μHE[n] ((fun x => c • x) '' R.carrier \ R.carrier) = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
    have hset : (fun x => c • x) '' R.carrier \ R.carrier =
        (fun x => c • x) '' (R.carrier \ (fun x => c⁻¹ • x) '' R.carrier) := by
      rw [image_sdiff (smul_right_injective _ hc0), image_image]
      simp [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0]
    rw [hset, image_smul, Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀ n hc0,
      hnull1 c⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hc), smul_zero]
  have hquasi : ∀ p : Euclid P → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, p x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, p (r • x) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [ae_iff] at hp ⊢
    obtain ⟨E, hBE, hEm, hE0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null hp
    refine measure_mono_null (t := (fun x => r⁻¹ • x) '' E) (fun x hx => ?_) ?_
    · exact ⟨r • x, hBE hx, by simp [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']⟩
    · rw [hscale r⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hr) E hEm, hE0, mul_zero]
  have hA : ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∃ Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier x Q :=
    (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _).ae_le (R.orients.mono fun x ⟨Q, hQ, _⟩ => ⟨Q, hQ⟩)
  have hcmp : ∀ (x : Euclid P) (Q₁ Q₂ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)),
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier x Q₁ →
      HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier (r • x) Q₂ → Q₁ = Q₂ := by
    intro x Q₁ Q₂ h₁ h₂
    have hdil : dilation (0 : Euclid P) r⁻¹ = fun z => r • z := by
      funext z
      simp [dilation, dilationCLM]
    have hi := Submission.dtc_approxTangent_dilation P n R.carrier 0 x r⁻¹ Q₁ (inv_pos.mpr hr) h₁
    rw [hdil] at hi
    have hii := Submission.dtc_approxTangent_of_null_diff P n _
      (R.carrier ∩ (fun z => r • z) '' R.carrier) univ (r • x) Q₁ inter_subset_right isOpen_univ
      (mem_univ _) (by rw [inter_univ, sdiff_inter_self_eq_sdiff]; exact hnull2 r hr) hi
    have hiii := Submission.dtc_approxTangent_of_null_diff P n R.carrier
      (R.carrier ∩ (fun z => r • z) '' R.carrier) univ (r • x) Q₂ inter_subset_left isOpen_univ
      (mem_univ _) (by rw [inter_univ, sdiff_self_inter]; exact hnull1 r hr) h₂
    exact hii.unique hiii
  filter_upwards [hA, hquasi _ hA] with x hx hrx
  have h₁ : HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier x (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x) := by
    unfold approxTangentPlane
    rw [dite_eq_left hx]
    exact hx.choose_spec
  have h₂ : HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier (r • x)
      (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier (r • x)) := by
    unfold approxTangentPlane
    rw [dite_eq_left hrx]
    exact hrx.choose_spec
  exact (hcmp x _ _ h₁ h₂).symm

subproblems.title: The weight of a cone current is homogeneous of degree n (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be a cone, i.e. η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0 (IsConeCurrent C), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing C, with weight μ = θH^n⌞M (R.measure). Then for every λ > 0 and every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P, μ(λA) = λ^n μ(A), where λA = {λa : a ∈ A}. (This is the comparator-accepted declaration Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image of DAG node root.half_space_cone_lies_in_boundary-a1.cone_measure_homogeneous-a1, reused here by exact name and frozen type.)
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * R.measure A
subproblems.natural_proof:
Reuse note: this child is the comparator-accepted and independently reviewed declaration Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image of DAG node root.half_space_cone_lies_in_boundary-a1.cone_measure_homogeneous-a1. It has been accepted since 2026-10-12T18:42:47Z (candidate commit e183b985f8baf48aa0fe07ee8e978c1474ec9d0a; comparator_passed = true; review method machine-nonleaf) and is reused here at its character-identical frozen Lean type, so no new proof work is required. Its own prerequisite imrep_measure_unique (Submission.imrep_measure_eq_of_represents_same_current, accepted, candidate 6907c2cb07a30284981f3f56aad0d3daf62d6314) and its five children are already discharged in that branch. In the selected node's supplied proof it is step 1, which steps 2 and 3 use: M and λM agree up to Hⁿ-null sets, and the exceptional set E is transported by x ↦ r⁻¹x. The accepted natural-language proof follows verbatim except for provenance wording: "parent step 3" now names the proof of root.half_space_cone_lies_in_boundary-a1, and the mentions of the prerequisite as a sibling (in the proof and in the key steps) now name the accepted declaration.
Source: step 3 (first half) of the proof of root.half_space_cone_lies_in_boundary-a1: "IsConeCurrent C gives η_{0,λ#}C = C for λ > 0; the mass measure of η_{0,λ#}C is λ^{−n}(η_{0,λ})_#μ (area formula for the homothety), so μ(λA) = λ^nμ(A) for Borel A" — Simon 7.4.5, proof line 698 ("by virtue of the fact that C is a cone", chapter-07.txt lines 697–699), push-forward Ch. 6, 2.23 (chapter-06.txt line 408) and the push-forward of integer multiplicity currents by the area formula Ch. 6, 3.3–3.6 (chapter-06.txt lines 770–830), and the representation independence of the mass measure, which is imrep_measure_unique of that branch (Submission.imrep_measure_eq_of_represents_same_current, comparator-accepted; Simon 6.3.2(3)).

Notation. M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient, H^n = μHE[n], μ = R.measure. Fix λ > 0 and put S(y) := λ^{-1}y; for a set A, λA := {λa : a ∈ A} = (x ↦ λx) '' A.
1. Scaling of H^n. For every set B and c > 0, H^n(cB) = c^n H^n(B) (Mathlib euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀). Consequently the push-forward of H^n⌞M under the homeomorphism S is λ^n·H^n⌞S(M): for Borel B, H^n(M ∩ S^{-1}(B)) = H^n(λ(S(M) ∩ B)) = λ^n H^n(S(M) ∩ B). Hence for every function F on ℝ^P (Bochner integral, or lower integral of F ≥ 0):
 (1.1) ∫_{S(M)} F dH^n = λ^{-n} ∫_M F(S(y)) dH^n(y),
 using the change of variables formula for the measurable embedding S (Mathlib integral_map_equiv / lintegral_map_equiv) and linearity in the measure.
2. The cone identity in terms of forms. For an n-covector α and c ∈ ℝ, α∘(c·id) = c^n α (multilinearity: α(cv_1,…,cv_n) = c^nα(v)). By the contract, blowUp C 0 λ is the push-forward of C by the proper affine map η(y) = −λ^{-1}·0 + λ^{-1}y = S(y), acting by (blowUp C 0 λ)(ω) = C(η^#ω) with (η^#ω)(y) = ω(S(y))∘(λ^{-1}id) = λ^{-n}ω(λ^{-1}y) (affinePullbackForm with L = λ^{-1}id, b = 0); η^#ω is again a test form because η is a proper affine isomorphism. The domain of blowUp C 0 λ is dilation 0 λ '' univ = univ, so every test form ω on ℝ^P satisfies the test-form condition in currentEval, and IsConeCurrent C gives
 (2.1) C(ω) = C(η^#ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P).
3. The rescaled triple R_λ := (M', θ', ξ') with M' := S(M) = λ^{-1}M, θ'(z) := θ(λz), ξ'(z) := ξ(λz) is an IMRep univ n:
 - M' is Borel (image of a Borel set under the homeomorphism S) and M' ⊆ univ.
 - M' is countably n-rectifiable: if M ⊆ M_0 ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝ^n) with H^n(M_0) = 0 and F_j Lipschitz, then M' ⊆ S(M_0) ∪ ⋃_j (S∘F_j)(ℝ^n), H^n(S(M_0)) = λ^{-n}H^n(M_0) = 0, and S∘F_j is Lipschitz.
 - θ' is measurable and θ'(z) = θ(λz) > 0 for z ∈ M' (since λz ∈ M).
 - For compact K: ∫_{M'∩K} θ' dH^n = λ^{-n} ∫_{M∩λK} θ dH^n < ∞ by (1.1) (M' ∩ K = S(M ∩ λK)) and the local integrability of θ on the compact set λK.
 - ξ' is a.e.-strongly measurable for H^n⌞M': the map z ↦ λz carries H^n⌞M' to λ^{-n}·H^n⌞M (by step 1), so composing the H^n⌞M-a.e.-strongly measurable ξ with it gives an H^n⌞M'-a.e.-strongly measurable function.
 - Orientation: let E ⊆ M be the H^n-null set off which R.orients holds. S(E) is H^n-null by step 1. For z ∈ M' ∖ S(E), y := λz ∈ M ∖ E, so there is an n-plane Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ y) Q. For r > 0, blowUpMap z r '' M' = {r^{-1}(λ^{-1}m − z) : m ∈ M} = {(λr)^{-1}(m − λz) : m ∈ M} = blowUpMap y (λr) '' M, and λr → 0⁺ as r → 0⁺; hence HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' z Q, and ξ'(z) = ξ(y) is a unit orientation of Q.
4. R_λ represents C. For ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), by (1.1) with F(z) = θ(λz)ξ(λz)(ω(z)) and linearity of ξ(y):
 R_λ.action(ω) = ∫_{M'} θ(λz) ξ(λz)(ω(z)) dH^n(z) = λ^{-n} ∫_M θ(y) ξ(y)(ω(λ^{-1}y)) dH^n(y) = ∫_M θ(y) ξ(y)(λ^{-n}ω(λ^{-1}y)) dH^n(y) = R.action(η^#ω) = C(η^#ω) = C(ω),
 the last two equalities by R.Represents C (η^#ω is a test form on ℝ^P) and (2.1).
5. By imrep_measure_unique (Submission.imrep_measure_eq_of_represents_same_current, comparator-accepted in that branch; applied with U = ℝ^P, which is open, to the two representations R_λ and R of C): R_λ.measure = R.measure.
6. For measurable A, M' ∩ A = S(M ∩ λA), so by (1.1) R_λ.measure(A) = ∫_{M'∩A} θ' dH^n = λ^{-n}∫_{M∩λA} θ dH^n = λ^{-n}·R.measure(λA). With step 5, R.measure(λA) = λ^n·R.measure(A), i.e. R.measure((x ↦ λx) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal(λ^n)·R.measure(A).
proof_key_steps: Pull-back by the dilation scales n-covectors by λ^{-n}; the cone property gives C(ω) = C(λ^{-n}ω(λ^{-1}·)) for all test forms.
The rescaled triple (λ^{-1}M, θ(λ·), ξ(λ·)) is an IMRep (rectifiability, integrability and approximate tangent planes rescale).
Change of variables (H^n(cB) = c^nH^n(B)) shows the rescaled triple represents C.
Uniqueness of the weight (accepted Submission.imrep_measure_eq_of_represents_same_current) gives λ^{-n}μ(λA) = μ(A).

subproblems.title: Approximate tangent spaces are invariant under dilations (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, x, y ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P and η = η_{x,λ} (dilation x λ, y ↦ λ⁻¹(y − x)). If Q is the approximate tangent space of M at y in the sense of Simon 3.1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q: dim Q = n and ∫_{η_{y,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P)), then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (η(M)) (η(y)) Q. (This is the comparator-accepted declaration Submission.dtc_approxTangent_dilation of DAG node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.blowup_scaling-a1.tangent_invariance-a1, reused here by exact name and frozen type.)
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < lam → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (dilation x lam '' M) (dilation x lam y) Q
subproblems.natural_proof:
Reuse note: this child is the comparator-accepted and independently reviewed declaration Submission.dtc_approxTangent_dilation of DAG node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.blowup_scaling-a1.tangent_invariance-a1. It has been accepted since 2026-10-12T03:14:27Z (candidate commit 2b0c51405c3f7d305798214e74d0447c1d210ae1; comparator_passed = true; review method machine-leaf) and is reused here at its character-identical frozen Lean type, so no new proof work is required. It has no prerequisites. In the selected node's supplied proof it is step 4(i), applied with base point 0 and scale r⁻¹: dilation 0 r⁻¹ z = −((r⁻¹)⁻¹•0) + (r⁻¹)⁻¹•z = rz, so HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q₁ yields HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (rM) (rx) Q₁. The accepted natural-language proof follows verbatim, except that "parent proof step 2" now names the proof of root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.blowup_scaling-a1.
Source: Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (chapter-03.txt lines 77–86), formalized by SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q := finrank Q = n ∧ ∀ f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P;ℝ), lim_{r→0+} ∫_{blowUpMap y r '' M} f dHⁿ = ∫_Q f dHⁿ, with blowUpMap y r w = r⁻¹•(w − y); step 2 of the proof of root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.blowup_scaling-a1, orientation bullet (η_{z,r}(η(M)) = η_{y,λr}(M)). Here η = η_{x,λ} = dilation x λ, Hⁿ = μHE[n].
1. The condition finrank Q = n involves neither M nor the base point, so it holds for η(M) at η(y).
2. Set identity. For w ∈ ℝ^P, η(w) − η(y) = (−λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹w) − (−λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹y) = λ⁻¹(w − y). Hence for every r ∈ ℝ, blowUpMap(η(y), r)(η(w)) = r⁻¹λ⁻¹(w − y) = (λr)⁻¹(w − y) = blowUpMap(y, λr)(w), using (λr)⁻¹ = λ⁻¹r⁻¹ (valid in ℝ with the convention 0⁻¹ = 0). Taking images of M: blowUpMap(η(y), r)(η(M)) = blowUpMap(y, λr)(M) for all r.
3. Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P;ℝ) and put g(s) := ∫_{blowUpMap(y,s)(M)} f dHⁿ. By step 2, for every r the integral ∫_{blowUpMap(η(y),r)(η(M))} f dHⁿ is literally g(λr) (same domain of integration, same integrand and same measure, so no integrability is needed for this identity).
4. The map r ↦ λr sends the filter r → 0+ into the filter s → 0+: it is continuous with value 0 at 0, and λr > 0 whenever r > 0 because λ > 0. By hypothesis g(s) → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as s → 0+. Composing the two limits, ∫_{blowUpMap(η(y),r)(η(M))} f dHⁿ = g(λr) → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as r → 0+.
5. Steps 1 and 4 are exactly HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (η(M)) (η(y)) Q. ∎
Formalization notes (this exact statement was proved in a scratch build): obtain ⟨hdim, hconv⟩; prove the set identity with image_image, congr, funext and the rewrite chain ← smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv, mul_comm, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right (after writing dilation x λ y = λ⁻¹ • (y − x)); simp_rw it; the filter limit by tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within with mul_pos; conclude with (hconv f).comp.
proof_key_steps: η(w) − η(y) = λ⁻¹(w − y), hence η_{η(y),r}(η(M)) = η_{y,λr}(M) for every r.
The rescaled integrals for η(M) at η(y) at scale r equal those for M at y at scale λr.
r ↦ λr maps r → 0+ to s → 0+, so the limit transfers; dim Q = n is unchanged.

subproblems.title: Approximate tangent planes are local and unchanged by removing Hⁿ-null sets (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M' ⊆ M ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets, V ⊆ ℝ^P open, x ∈ V, and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P. Suppose Hⁿ((M ∖ M') ∩ V) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Suppose Q is the approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q): dim Q = n, and lim_{r↓0} ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ = ∫_Q f dHⁿ for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x). Then Q is also the approximate tangent space of M' at x. (This is the comparator-accepted declaration Submission.dtc_approxTangent_of_null_diff of DAG node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.localize-a1.approx_tangent_local-a1, reused here by exact name and frozen type.)
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' V : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), M' ⊆ M → IsOpen V → x ∈ V → μHE[n] ((M \ M') ∩ V) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
subproblems.natural_proof:
Reuse note: this child is the comparator-accepted and independently reviewed declaration Submission.dtc_approxTangent_of_null_diff of DAG node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.localize-a1.approx_tangent_local-a1. It has been accepted since 2026-10-12T15:42:50Z (candidate commit 022bd01bf7500f65a1cfbba033ecf91be9652452; comparator_passed = true; review method machine-leaf) and is reused here at its character-identical frozen Lean type, so no new proof work is required. It has no prerequisites. In the selected node's supplied proof it is used twice, in steps 4(ii) and 4(iii), with V = ℝ^P (open, containing rx) and M' = M ∩ rM, inside rM and inside M respectively. The accepted natural-language proof follows verbatim, except that "the parent proof" now names the proof of root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.localize-a1.
Source: Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (chapter-03.txt lines 77–85). This is the locality fact behind step 5 (orientation of M ∩ U') and step 6.6 (M_X and M_X ∩ K differ by an Hⁿ-null set) of the proof of root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.localize-a1.
Notation: μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n]; η_r := η_{x,r} = Chapter03.blowUpMap x r; for an arbitrary set A, ∫_A f dμ := ∫ f d(μ⌞A) (Mathlib's set integal). No measurability of A is needed below.
1. Reduction. The condition dim Q = n is part of the hypothesis and does not involve M. Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P). By hypothesis ∫_{η_r(M)} f dμ → ∫_Q f dμ as r ↓ 0. So it suffices to find r₀ > 0 with ∫_{η_r(M')} f dμ = ∫_{η_r(M)} f dμ for all r ∈ (0, r₀). The two functions of r then agree on (0, r₀), a set in the filter 𝓝[>] 0 (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT), so they have the same limit (Tendsto.congr').
2. Choice of r₀. V is open and x ∈ V, so choose s > 0 with B_s(x) ⊆ V. tsupport f is compact, hence bounded, so choose L > 0 with tsupport f ⊆ B := B_L(0) (open ball). Then f(y) = 0 for y ∉ B. Put r₀ := s/L > 0 and fix r ∈ (0, r₀).
3. Cutting to B. For every set A ⊆ ℝ^P, ∫_A f dμ = ∫_{B∩A} f dμ. Indeed f vanishes off B, so ∫ f d(μ⌞A) = ∫_B f d(μ⌞A) (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero). And (μ⌞A)⌞B = μ⌞(B ∩ A) because B is Borel (Measure.restrict_restrict).
4. η_r maps μ-null sets to μ-null sets. |η_r(a) − η_r(b)| = r⁻¹|a − b|, so η_r is Lipschitz with constant r⁻¹, and μH[n](η_r(N)) ≤ (r⁻¹)ⁿ μH[n](N) for every N ⊆ ℝ^P (LipschitzWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le). μHE[n] = c·μH[n] with a constant c ∈ (0, ∞) (Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_def; addHaarScalarFactor_volume_hausdorffMeasure_ne_zero), so μ and μH[n] have the same null sets. Hence μ(N) = 0 implies μ(η_r(N)) = 0. Apply this to N := (M ∖ M') ∩ V, which is μ-null by hypothesis: μ(η_r(N)) = 0.
5. (B ∩ η_r(M)) ∖ (B ∩ η_r(M')) ⊆ η_r(N). Let y ∈ B with y = η_r(z) for some z ∈ M, and y ∉ η_r(M'). Then z ∉ M', since otherwise y ∈ η_r(M'). Inverting η_r gives z = x + r·y, so |z − x| = r|y| < rL < r₀L = s and z ∈ B_s(x) ⊆ V. Thus z ∈ (M ∖ M') ∩ V = N and y = η_r(z) ∈ η_r(N).
6. M' ⊆ M gives B ∩ η_r(M') ⊆ B ∩ η_r(M), so (B ∩ η_r(M')) ∖ (B ∩ η_r(M)) = ∅. With steps 4–5, μ((B ∩ η_r(M)) ∖ (B ∩ η_r(M'))) = 0. Hence B ∩ η_r(M') and B ∩ η_r(M) are μ-a.e. equal (ae_eq_set), and μ⌞(B ∩ η_r(M')) = μ⌞(B ∩ η_r(M)) (Measure.restrict_congr_set).
7. By steps 3 and 6, for every r ∈ (0, r₀): ∫_{η_r(M')} f dμ = ∫_{B∩η_r(M')} f dμ = ∫_{B∩η_r(M)} f dμ = ∫_{η_r(M)} f dμ. By step 1, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q. ∎
proof_key_steps: Only the blow-up integrals need checking. For f ∈ C_c pick L with spt f ⊆ B_L(0) and s with B_s(x) ⊆ V, and take 0 < r < s/L.
Each blow-up integral equals its integral over B_L(0). For such r, the parts of η_r(M) and η_r(M') inside B_L(0) differ by a subset of η_r((M ∖ M') ∩ V).
η_r is Lipschitz, so this set is Hⁿ-null. The restricted measures coincide, so the integrals agree for all small r and the limits are equal.
